newsitem.title: KENYA: Kenya tea prices up on improved general demand.
newsitem.headline: Kenya tea prices up on improved general demand.

text.p: Kenyan tea prices rose on improved demand at the weekly export auction, officials said.

Brighter BP1s rose two to four US cents while mediums gained four to six cents but lower mediums were barely steady. Brighter and medium PF1s were three to six cents up following quality while lower and medium and plainer descriptions were firm to dearer. Brighter PDusts rose two to four cents while mediums eased. In secondary catalogues selected brighter fannings and dusts were dearer and others lost value.
Pakistan was more active with sustained demand from Egypt, Sudan and the Middle East.
